Press and media kit

Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market retailers running 5 to 50 warehouses. Journalists may reuse the boilerplate below verbatim.

Contact the press office

Approved boilerplate

Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market retailers running 5 to 50 warehouses. Founded in Portland, Oregon in 2019, the company serves 140 retail customers across the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada.

Founding facts

Incorporated 11 March 2019 in Portland, Oregon. Founders: Dana Okonkwo and Ravi Sethuraman. Headcount 31 as of June 2026. Offices in Portland and Manchester.

Named spokesperson

Dana Okonkwo, chief executive, is the named spokesperson for all media enquiries. Requests go to press@brightpath-analytics.example and are answered within one working day.

Logo and brand assets

The logo pack contains SVG and PNG marks in full colour and single colour. Do not recolour the mark or set it on a background below 30% contrast.
